facts.label: Who issues the policy?
facts.text: Progressive Home policies are placed through Progressive Advantage Agency with affiliated and unaffiliated insurers. Each insurer is responsible for its own claims.

facts.label: Shopping channel matters
facts.text: The available insurers can depend on whether you buy directly or through an independent agent or broker. Prices, coverage and privacy policies differ by insurer.

facts.label: Discount limits
facts.text: Coverage and discounts are not available in every state or situation. Identify the issuing insurer and review its policy terms before comparing a home and auto bundle.
